text:
jess: Heads-up — our webinar-to-lead conversion is down 28% week-over-week on the marketing dashboard. GA4 shows sessions steady but HubSpot leads dropped. Anyone else seeing this?
omar: I noticed an uptick in reg form errors around Thu 14:30 UTC. logging a quick look now.
maya: sharing dashboard: https://app.redwood/dashboard/marketing/webinar-funnel — the conversion tile tanks after Mar 15.
liam: possible UTM mismatch: some ad sets used `utm_campaign=launch_q1` while others used `launch-q1`. that would push conversions to direct or other.
jess: can we quantify how many leads would reattach if we normalize UTMs?
omar: quick SQL run: `select count(*) from forms where created_at > '2026-03-15' and error = true and form = 'webinar'` → 42. attaching snippet.
maya: 42 form errors is small compared to the ~300 lead gap. likely multi-factor.
anne: FYI I rolled a redirect change to /webinar/register on 2026-03-16 — tagging @deploy-bot for the deploy window.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-16T12:05 by anne to prod — service: /webinar/register v2.3.1 — no rollbacks.
liam: also found a GA4 filter applied Mar 15 that excludes internal IP ranges; if tracking was misconfigured we could lose attributed conversions.
jess: proposed actions: 1) liam — estimate leads recoverable via UTM normalization; 2) omar — tally reg errors and root cause; 3) maya — quantify GA4 filter impact; 4) jess — crosswalk CRM vs GA4 for last 14 days.
maya: I'll build a quick viz comparing GA4 session->events vs HubSpot creates and drop a screenshot here.
liam: running UTM-normalize script now, will report counts.
omar: error log snippet: ```POST /register 500 {"message":"timeout writing to redis"}``` — looks transient but could affect some users.
jess: reconvene in 45m — post interim numbers here. :hourglass: 
maya: interim GA4 filter impact estimate = -70 leads (sessions filtered).
liam: preliminary UTM-normalized uplift = +220 leads (remap `launch_q1` & `launch-q1`).
omar: reg error root cause appears to be a short-lived redis timeout from 14:22–14:35 UTC, ~42 failed submits.
jess: combined estimates ~292 leads, which aligns with the observed ~300 drop. great sleuthing. next steps: add UTM normalization in ETL, add dashboard alert for sudden attribution drops, and runbook for reg-service rollback checklist.
anne: I will own the runbook + a quick postmortem doc.
jess: perfect — thanks everyone :raised_hands:
maya: i'll post the viz & the GA4 vs HS crosswalk link in #marketing after this thread.
liam: created a quick card in the backlog: normalize-utms (priority: high).
jess: closing the huddle — will follow up with a short postmortem and actions.
